title: VethuQ add-on and bundle catalog payload (schema v1)
description: The payload carried inside the signed envelope of /v1/catalog.json: the add-ons and bundles that exist, with descriptions, so a person can see what is available and ask for it. Changes within schema major 1 are additive only; clients MUST ignore unknown fields, so additionalProperties is intentionally left open everywhere. All text is plain text, never HTML.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number of the catalog (its own counter, separate from the policy's). Clients reject a lower one than they accepted from the same key.

kid.description: Id of the signing key. Must equal the kid in the envelope.

request_url.description: Where a person goes to ask for an add-on or bundle. Used when an entry has no request_url of its own.

addons.description: Every add-on that exists, by its add-on id.

bundles.description: Every bundle: add-ons that are licensed together.

status.description: available, coming_soon (announced, not released) or deprecated (still works, no longer offered). Clients treat a status they do not know as available.

text.description: Optional translations of the text fields, by language id (`es`, `te`). The entry's own fields are the fallback.

description.description: Plain text, a few paragraphs at most.

kind.description: What it adds: file-type, language, search-engine, ocr, tier, backup or another word. Clients show a kind they do not know as it is.

bundles.description: Ids of the bundles that include it.

addons.description: Ids of the add-ons it includes.
